description: This file contains implementation of weight normalization functions within the PyTorch library's 'aten' (tensor algebra) component. It defines functions for computing weight normalization, its backward pass, and auxiliary tensor operations such as norm_except_dim, with references to external kernel dispatchers and tensor utility functions.

methods.name: Tensor norm_except_dim(const Tensor & v,int64_t pow,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Computes the norm of tensor 'v' along a specified dimension 'dim' with a given power 'pow', handling special cases for first and last dimensions for efficiency.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,Tensor> weight_norm_cpu(const Tensor & v,const Tensor & g,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Computes weight normalization on CPU for input tensors 'v' and 'g' along a specified dimension, returning the normalized weights and norms.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,Tensor> weight_norm_backward_cpu(const Tensor & grad_w,const Tensor & saved_v,const Tensor & saved_g,const Tensor & saved_norm,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Performs the backward pass for weight normalization on CPU, returning gradients with respect to 'v' and 'g'.

methods.name: Tensor _weight_norm(const Tensor & v_in,const Tensor & g_in,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Calculates weight normalization for input tensors 'v_in' and 'g_in' along a specified dimension, choosing optimized methods when possible.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,Tensor> _weight_norm_differentiable_backward(const Tensor & grad_w,const Tensor & saved_v,const Tensor & saved_g,const Tensor & saved_norms,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Provides the backward computation for weight normalization when creating a computational graph, used during autograd with differentiable paths.
